SWIFT001.title: Warnings-as-errors override
SWIFT001.action: Keep Kotlin generated bridges and Swift dependencies/tests strict; repair the producer or source API.

SWIFT002.title: Missing or weaker explicit Swift 6 mode
SWIFT002.action: Review authored Swift 6 versus generated Swift 5 package policy first. For an authored package, invoke the standalone Swift6ManifestEnforcer with an explicit manifest and receipt; verify actual frontend flags.

SWIFT003.title: Generated declaration rewrite or deletion
SWIFT003.action: Remove generated API/body rewriting. Repair the actual source/producer and regenerate, preserving declarations.

SWIFT004.title: Implementation-only generated import
SWIFT004.action: Inspect strict frontend diagnostics and library evolution settings. Do not blindly rewrite generated imports.

SWIFT005.title: Known generated KotlinError storage shape
SWIFT005.action: Check Swift 6 Sendable diagnostics for KotlinBase storage; isolated runtime candidates are not verified product fixes.

SWIFT006.title: Known generated bridge warning shape
SWIFT006.action: Use the documented concrete API/nominal callback recipes; regenerate and strictly compile. A pattern match is not a compiler verdict.

SWIFT007.title: Unverified toolchain or diagnostic bypass
SWIFT007.action: Keep isolated enum/cancellation/runtime candidates gated; no patched exporter adoption or warning suppression through sync.

SWIFT008.title: Placeholder Swift consumer assertion
SWIFT008.action: Replace unconditional assertions with actual project API behavior tests before release acceptance.

candidate_policy.enum: unverified for product integration; preserve immutable isolated results
candidate_policy.KotlinError/cancellation: unverified complete runtime repair; no fleet adoption
candidate_policy.verified_defaults: explicit Swift6 and warnings-as-errors policy; template compiler/runtime acceptance remains separate

acceptance_contract: Fresh exact source and generated Swift/Kotlin bridge file hashes
Actual Swift6/warnings-as-errors frontend command evidence for every generated Swift dependency module and consumer
Actual named consumer tests, no failure/error/skip; no placeholder assertions
Exact toolchain file hashes; source scan findings remain distinct from compiler diagnostics
